refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoSyntaxTreeGetType` function gets the type of the `SyntaxTreeNodeObject`.
* `SyntaxTree` is the syntax tree node to prove for its type.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoSyntaxTreeGetType` returns a value indicating whether the syntax tree node is a leaf, branch, error, or nothing.
